description: This file defines a Java interface WebHookService used for making HTTP requests related to webhooks, SMS bridges, and platform actions within the Fineract infrastructure. It specifies various methods for sending GET and POST requests with different payloads and headers, facilitating integration with external systems via Retrofit HTTP client.

classes.name: WebHookService
classes.description: Interface for defining webhook and SMS bridge HTTP API calls using Retrofit.

methods.name: sendEmptyRequest
methods.description: Performs a simple GET request to check server availability or ping.

methods.name: sendJsonRequest
methods.description: Sends a POST request with a JSON payload to a specified endpoint, with headers for entity, action, tenant, and endpoint.

methods.name: sendFormRequest
methods.description: Sends a POST request with form URL-encoded parameters, with headers similar to sendJsonRequest.

methods.name: sendSmsBridgeRequest
methods.description: Sends an SMS bridge request with JSON body, using headers for entity, action, tenant, and API key.

methods.name: sendSmsBridgeConfigRequest
methods.description: Sends a configuration request for SMS provider using a JSON payload.
